statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.printify_webhook_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (char_length(event_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
